verses.original: הַחֲרִ֤ישׁוּ אֵלַי֙ אִיִּ֔ים וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים יַחֲלִ֣יפוּ כֹ֑חַ יִגְּשׁוּ֙ אָ֣ז יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ יַחְדָּ֖ו נִקְרָֽבָה׃ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥă·rî·šū ’ê·lay ’î·yîm ū·lə·’um·mîm ya·ḥă·lî·p̄ū ḵō·aḥ yig·gə·šū ’āz yə·ḏab·bê·rū yaḥ·dāw niq·rā·ḇāh lam·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Be silent before Me O islands and let the peoples renew their strength Let them come forward and testify let us together draw near for judgment

verses.original: מִ֤י הֵעִיר֙ מִמִּזְרָ֔ח יִקְרָאֵ֣הוּ לְרַגְל֑וֹ צֶ֖דֶק גּוֹיִם֙ יִתֵּ֨ן לְפָנָ֤יו יַ֔רְדְּ וּמְלָכִ֣ים יִתֵּ֤ן כֶּֽעָפָר֙ חַרְבּ֔וֹ נִדָּ֖ף כְּקַ֥שׁ קַשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mî hê·‘îr mim·miz·rāḥ yiq·rā·’ê·hū lə·raḡ·lōw ṣe·ḏeq gō·w·yim yit·tên lə·p̄ā·nāw yard ū·mə·lā·ḵîm yit·tên ke·‘ā·p̄ār ḥar·bōw nid·dāp̄ kə·qaš qaš·tōw
verses.literal: Who has aroused one from the east [and] called him to his feet in righteousness He hands nations over to him [and] subdues kings [before him] He turns them to dust with his sword to windblown chaff with his bow

verses.original: יִרְדְּפֵ֖ם יַעֲב֣וֹר שָׁל֑וֹם לֹ֥א יָבֽוֹא׃ אֹ֥רַח בְּרַגְלָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: yir·də·p̄êm ya·‘ă·ḇō·wr šā·lō·wm lō yā·ḇō·w ’ō·raḥ bə·raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: He pursues them going on safely hardly touching the path with his feet

verses.original: מִֽי־ פָעַ֣ל וְעָשָׂ֔ה קֹרֵ֥א הַדֹּר֖וֹת מֵרֹ֑אשׁ אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ רִאשׁ֔וֹן וְאֶת־ אַחֲרֹנִ֖ים אֲנִי־ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: mî- p̄ā·‘al wə·‘ā·śāh qō·rê had·dō·rō·wṯ mê·rōš ’ă·nî Yah·weh ri·šō·wn wə·’eṯ- ’a·ḥă·rō·nîm ’ă·nî- hū
verses.literal: Who has performed this and carried it out calling forth the generations from the beginning I the LORD the first and the last I am He

verses.original: אִיִּים֙ רָא֤וּ וְיִירָ֔אוּ קְצ֥וֹת הָאָ֖רֶץ יֶחֱרָ֑דוּ קָרְב֖וּ וַיֶּאֱתָיֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·yîm rā·’ū wə·yî·rā·’ū qə·ṣō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ye·ḥĕ·rā·ḏū qā·rə·ḇū way·ye·’ĕ·ṯā·yūn
verses.literal: The islands see and fear the ends of the earth tremble They approach and come forward

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ יַעְזֹ֑רוּ רֵעֵ֖הוּ יֹאמַ֥ר וּלְאָחִ֖יו חֲזָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’eṯ- ya‘·zō·rū rê·‘ê·hū yō·mar ū·lə·’ā·ḥîw ḥă·zāq
verses.literal: Each one - helps the other and says to his brother Be strong

verses.original: חָרָשׁ֙ אֶת־ וַיְחַזֵּ֤ק צֹרֵ֔ף מַחֲלִ֥יק פַּטִּ֖ישׁ אֶת־ ה֣וֹלֶם פָּ֑עַם אֹמֵ֤ר לַדֶּ֙בֶק֙ ה֔וּא ט֣וֹב וַיְחַזְּקֵ֥הוּ בְמַסְמְרִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִמּֽוֹט׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥā·rāš ’eṯ- way·ḥaz·zêq ṣō·rêp̄ ma·ḥă·lîq paṭ·ṭîš ’eṯ- hō·w·lem pā·‘am ’ō·mêr lad·de·ḇeq hū ṭō·wḇ way·ḥaz·zə·qê·hū ḇə·mas·mə·rîm lō yim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: The craftsman - encourages the goldsmith [and] he who wields the hammer - [cheers] him who strikes the anvil saying of the welding It is good He nails it down . . . so it will not be toppled

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדִּ֔י יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּחַרְתִּ֑יךָ זֶ֖רַע אַבְרָהָ֥ם אֹהֲבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḇ·dî ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ă·šer bə·ḥar·tî·ḵā ze·ra‘ ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ō·hă·ḇî
verses.literal: But you O Israel My servant Jacob whom I have chosen descendant of Abraham My friend

verses.original: הֶחֱזַקְתִּ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִקְצ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ קְרָאתִ֑יךָ וּמֵאֲצִילֶ֖יהָ וָאֹ֤מַר לְךָ֙ אַ֔תָּה עַבְדִּי־ בְּחַרְתִּ֖יךָ וְלֹ֥א מְאַסְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: he·ḥĕ·zaq·tî·ḵā ’ă·šer miq·ṣō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ qə·rā·ṯî·ḵā ū·mê·’ă·ṣî·le·hā wā·’ō·mar lə·ḵā ’at·tāh ‘aḇ·dî- bə·ḥar·tî·ḵā wə·lō mə·’as·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: I brought you from the ends of the earth and called you from its farthest corners I said You are My servant I have chosen and not rejected you

verses.original: אַל־ תִּירָא֙ כִּ֣י אָ֔נִי עִמְּךָ־ אַל־ תִּשְׁתָּ֖ע כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אִמַּצְתִּ֙יךָ֙ אַף־ עֲזַרְתִּ֔יךָ אַף־ תְּמַכְתִּ֖יךָ צִדְקִֽי׃ בִּימִ֥ין
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rā kî ’ā·nî ‘im·mə·ḵā- ’al- tiš·tā‘ kî- ’ă·nî ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’im·maṣ·tî·ḵā ’ap̄- ‘ă·zar·tî·ḵā ’ap̄- tə·maḵ·tî·ḵā ṣiḏ·qî bî·mîn
verses.literal: Do not fear for I am with you do not be afraid for I am your God I will strengthen you vvv I will surely help you . . . I will uphold you with My righteous right hand

verses.original: הֵ֤ן כֹּ֖ל הַנֶּחֱרִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ יֵבֹ֙שׁוּ֙ וְיִכָּ֣לְמ֔וּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י רִיבֶֽךָ׃ יִֽהְי֥וּ כְאַ֛יִן וְיֹאבְד֖וּ
verses.transliteration: hên kōl han·ne·ḥĕ·rîm bāḵ yê·ḇō·šū wə·yik·kā·lə·mū ’an·šê rî·ḇe·ḵā yih·yū ḵə·’a·yin wə·yō·ḇə·ḏū
verses.literal: Behold all who rage against you will be ashamed and disgraced those who contend with you will be reduced to nothing and will perish

verses.original: תְּבַקְשֵׁם֙ אַנְשֵׁ֖י מַצֻּתֶ֑ךָ וְלֹ֣א תִמְצָאֵ֔ם מִלְחַמְתֶּֽךָ׃ אַנְשֵׁ֥י יִהְי֥וּ כְאַ֛יִן וּכְאֶ֖פֶס
verses.transliteration: tə·ḇaq·šêm ’an·šê maṣ·ṣu·ṯe·ḵā wə·lō ṯim·ṣā·’êm mil·ḥam·te·ḵā ’an·šê yih·yū ḵə·’a·yin ū·ḵə·’e·p̄es
verses.literal: You will seek [them] . . . but will not find them Those who wage war against you will come to nothing . . .

verses.original: כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מַחֲזִ֣יק יְמִינֶ֑ךָ הָאֹמֵ֥ר לְךָ֛ אַל־ תִּירָ֖א אֲנִ֥י עֲזַרְתִּֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ma·ḥă·zîq yə·mî·ne·ḵā hā·’ō·mêr lə·ḵā ’al- tî·rā ’ă·nî ‘ă·zar·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: For I am the LORD your God who takes hold of your right hand and tells you Do not fear I will help you

verses.original: אַל־ תִּֽירְאִי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב תּוֹלַ֣עַת מְתֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֤י עֲזַרְתִּיךְ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְגֹאֲלֵ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rə·’î ya·‘ă·qōḇ tō·w·la·‘aṯ mə·ṯê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·nî ‘ă·zar·tîḵ nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·ḡō·’ă·lêḵ qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Do not fear O Jacob you worm O few men of Israel I will help you declares the LORD Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה שַׂמְתִּ֗יךְ לְמוֹרַג֙ חָדָ֔שׁ חָר֣וּץ בַּ֖עַל פִּֽיפִיּ֑וֹת תָּד֤וּשׁ הָרִים֙ וְתָדֹ֔ק תָּשִֽׂים׃ וּגְבָע֖וֹת כַּמֹּ֥ץ
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh śam·tîḵ lə·mō·w·raḡ ḥā·ḏāš ḥā·rūṣ ba·‘al pî·p̄î·yō·wṯ tā·ḏūš hā·rîm wə·ṯā·ḏōq tā·śîm ū·ḡə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ kam·mōṣ
verses.literal: Behold I will make you into a threshing sledge new [and] sharp with many teeth You will thresh the mountains and crush them and reduce the hills to chaff

verses.original: תִּזְרֵם֙ וְר֣וּחַ תִּשָּׂאֵ֔ם וּסְעָרָ֖ה תָּפִ֣יץ אוֹתָ֑ם וְאַתָּה֙ תָּגִ֣יל בַּֽיהוָ֔ה תִּתְהַלָּֽל׃פ בִּקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: tiz·rêm wə·rū·aḥ tiś·śā·’êm ū·sə·‘ā·rāh tā·p̄îṣ ’ō·w·ṯām wə·’at·tāh tā·ḡîl Yah·weh tiṯ·hal·lāl biq·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: You will winnow them and a wind will carry them away a gale will scatter them But you will rejoice in the LORD you will glory in the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: הָעֲנִיִּ֨ים וְהָאֶבְיוֹנִ֜ים מְבַקְשִׁ֥ים מַ֙יִם֙ וָאַ֔יִן לְשׁוֹנָ֖ם נָשָׁ֑תָּה בַּצָּמָ֣א אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶעֱנֵ֔ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א אֶעֶזְבֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ă·nî·yîm wə·hā·’eḇ·yō·w·nîm mə·ḇaq·šîm ma·yim wā·’a·yin lə·šō·w·nām nā·šāt·tāh baṣ·ṣā·mā ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’e·‘ĕ·nêm ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl lō ’e·‘ez·ḇêm
verses.literal: The poor and needy seek water but there is none their tongues are parched with thirst I the LORD will answer them I, the God of Israel will not forsake them

verses.original: אֶפְתַּ֤ח נְהָר֔וֹת עַל־ שְׁפָיִים֙ מַעְיָנ֑וֹת וּבְת֥וֹךְ בְּקָע֖וֹת אָשִׂ֤ים מִדְבָּר֙ לַאֲגַם־ מַ֔יִם צִיָּ֖ה וְאֶ֥רֶץ לְמוֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·taḥ nə·hā·rō·wṯ ‘al- šə·p̄ā·yîm ma‘·yā·nō·wṯ ū·ḇə·ṯō·wḵ bə·qā·‘ō·wṯ ’ā·śîm miḏ·bār la·’ă·ḡam- ma·yim ṣî·yāh wə·’e·reṣ lə·mō·w·ṣā·’ê mā·yim
verses.literal: I will open rivers on the barren heights and fountains in the middle of the valleys I will turn the desert into a pool of water and the dry land into flowing springs . . .

verses.original: אֶתֵּ֤ן אֶ֣רֶז בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ שִׁטָּ֔ה וַהֲדַ֖ס שָׁ֑מֶן וְעֵ֣ץ אָשִׂ֣ים בְּר֛וֹשׁ בָּעֲרָבָ֗ה תִּדְהָ֥ר וּתְאַשּׁ֖וּר יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: ’et·tên ’e·rez bam·miḏ·bār šiṭ·ṭāh wa·hă·ḏas šā·men wə·‘êṣ ’ā·śîm bə·rō·wōš bā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh tiḏ·hār ū·ṯə·’aš·šūr yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: I will plant cedars in the wilderness acacias myrtles and olive trees I will set cypresses in the desert elms and boxwood together

verses.original: לְמַ֧עַן יַחְדָּ֔ו יִרְא֣וּ וְיֵדְע֗וּ וְיָשִׂ֤ימוּ וְיַשְׂכִּ֙ילוּ֙ כִּ֥י יַד־ יְהוָ֖ה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּ֑את וּקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרָאָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yaḥ·dāw yir·’ū wə·yê·ḏə·‘ū wə·yā·śî·mū wə·yaś·kî·lū kî yaḏ- Yah·weh ‘ā·śə·ṯāh zōṯ ū·qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl bə·rā·’āh
verses.literal: so that all may see and know may consider and understand that the hand of the LORD has done this and the Holy One of Israel has created it

verses.original: קָרְב֥וּ רִֽיבְכֶ֖ם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הַגִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ עֲצֻמ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם יֹאמַ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·ḇū rî·ḇə·ḵem yō·mar Yah·weh hag·gî·šū ‘ă·ṣu·mō·w·ṯê·ḵem yō·mar me·leḵ ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Present your case says the LORD Submit your arguments says the King of Jacob

verses.original: יַגִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ וְיַגִּ֣ידוּ לָ֔נוּ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקְרֶ֑ינָה הַגִּ֜ידוּ הָרִאשֹׁנ֣וֹת׀ מָ֣ה הֵ֗נָּה וְנָשִׂ֤ימָה לִבֵּ֙נוּ֙ וְנֵדְעָ֣ה אַחֲרִיתָ֔ן א֥וֹ הַשְׁמִיעֻֽנוּ׃ הַבָּא֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: yag·gî·šū wə·yag·gî·ḏū lā·nū ’êṯ ’ă·šer tiq·re·nāh hag·gî·ḏū hā·ri·šō·nō·wṯ māh hên·nāh wə·nā·śî·māh lib·bê·nū wə·nê·ḏə·‘āh ’a·ḥă·rî·ṯān ’ōw haš·mî·‘u·nū hab·bā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Let them come and tell us - what will happen Tell the former things . . . . . . so that we may reflect on them and know the outcome Or announce to us what is coming

verses.original: הַגִּ֙ידוּ֙ הָאֹתִיּ֣וֹת לְאָח֔וֹר וְנֵ֣דְעָ֔ה כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֑ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים אַף־ תֵּיטִ֣יבוּ וְתָרֵ֔עוּ וְנִשְׁתָּ֖עָה וְנִרָא יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gî·ḏū hā·’ō·ṯî·yō·wṯ lə·’ā·ḥō·wr wə·nê·ḏə·‘āh kî ’at·tem ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ap̄- tê·ṭî·ḇū wə·ṯā·rê·‘ū wə·niš·tā·‘āh wə·ni·rå̄ yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: Tell us the things that are to come so that we may know that you are gods Yes do something good or evil that we may look on together in dismay . . . . . .

verses.original: הֵן־ אַתֶּ֣ם מֵאַ֔יִן וּפָעָלְכֶ֖ם מֵאָ֑פַע יִבְחַ֥ר בָּכֶֽם׃ תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: hên- ’at·tem mê·’a·yin ū·p̄ā·‘ā·lə·ḵem mê·’ā·p̄a‘ yiḇ·ḥar bā·ḵem tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh
verses.literal: Behold you are nothing and your work is of no value Anyone who chooses you is detestable

verses.original: הַעִיר֤וֹתִי מִצָּפוֹן֙ וַיַּ֔את מִמִּזְרַח־ שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ יִקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֑י וְיָבֹ֤א סְגָנִים֙ כְּמוֹ־ חֹ֔מֶר וּכְמ֥וֹ יוֹצֵ֖ר יִרְמָס־ טִֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: ha·‘î·rō·w·ṯî miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn way·yaṯ mim·miz·raḥ- še·meš yiq·rā ḇiš·mî wə·yā·ḇō sə·ḡā·nîm kə·mōw- ḥō·mer ū·ḵə·mōw yō·w·ṣêr yir·mās- ṭîṭ
verses.literal: I have raised up [one] from the north and he has come one from the east . . . who calls on My name He will march over rulers as if they were mortar like a potter who treads the clay

verses.original: מִֽי־ הִגִּ֤יד מֵרֹאשׁ֙ וְנֵדָ֔עָה וּמִלְּפָנִ֖ים וְנֹאמַ֣ר צַדִּ֑יק אַ֣ף אֵין־ מַגִּ֗יד אַ֚ף אֵ֣ין מַשְׁמִ֔יעַ אַ֥ף אֵין־ שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אִמְרֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mî- hig·gîḏ mê·rōš wə·nê·ḏā·‘āh ū·mil·lə·p̄ā·nîm wə·nō·mar ṣad·dîq ’ap̄ ’ên- mag·gîḏ ’ap̄ ’ên maš·mî·a‘ ’ap̄ ’ên- šō·mê·a‘ ’im·rê·ḵem
verses.literal: Who has declared [this] from the beginning so that we may know and from times past so that we may say He was right . . . No one announced it . . . no one foretold it . . . no one heard your words

verses.original: רִאשׁ֥וֹן לְצִיּ֖וֹן הִנֵּ֣ה הִנָּ֑ם אֶתֵּֽן׃ וְלִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מְבַשֵּׂ֥ר
verses.transliteration: ri·šō·wn lə·ṣî·yō·wn hin·nêh hin·nām ’et·tên wə·lî·rū·šā·lim mə·ḇaś·śêr
verses.literal: I was the first to tell Zion Look here they are And I gave to Jerusalem a herald of good news

verses.original: וְאֵ֙רֶא֙ וְאֵ֣ין אִ֔ישׁ וְאֵ֣ין יוֹעֵ֑ץ וּמֵאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶשְׁאָלֵ֖ם וְיָשִׁ֥יבוּ דָבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ê·re wə·’ên ’îš wə·’ên yō·w·‘êṣ ū·mê·’êl·leh wə·’eš·’ā·lêm wə·yā·šî·ḇū ḏā·ḇār
verses.literal: When I look there is no one there is no counselor among them when I ask them they have nothing to say . . .

verses.original: הֵ֣ן כֻּלָּ֔ם אָ֥וֶן מַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם אֶ֖פֶס נִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃פ וָתֹ֖הוּ ר֥וּחַ
verses.transliteration: hên kul·lām ’ā·wen ma·‘ă·śê·hem ’e·p̄es nis·kê·hem wā·ṯō·hū rū·aḥ
verses.literal: See [they are] all a delusion their works amount to nothing their images are as empty as the wind
